badges.name: Bug Squasher
badges.description: Fixed a tricky bug and documented it

days.title: Environment Setup & Hello World
days.description: Set up your development environment with VS Code, Node.js, and Git. Create your first HTML page and push it to a public GitHub repository. This is your foundation — every great project starts with a solid setup.
objectives: Install VS Code, Node.js (LTS), and Git
Create a simple HTML page with your name and a greeting
Initialize a Git repo, commit, and push to GitHub
Write your first LinkedIn post about starting the challenge

days.title: HTML & Semantic Markup
days.description: Build a structured personal portfolio page using semantic HTML5 elements. Learn why semantic markup matters for accessibility and SEO. Your portfolio will evolve throughout this challenge.
objectives: Use semantic tags: header, nav, main, section, article, footer
Create a navigation menu with anchor links
Build an About, Projects, and Contact section
Validate your HTML using the W3C validator

days.title: CSS Fundamentals & Flexbox
days.description: Style your portfolio with modern CSS. Master Flexbox for building flexible, responsive layouts. Learn the box model, selectors, and CSS custom properties for a consistent design system.
objectives: Style your portfolio with colors, typography, and spacing
Use CSS custom properties (variables) for a design system
Build a responsive navbar and card layout with Flexbox
Add hover transitions on interactive elements

days.title: JavaScript Basics & DOM
days.description: Bring your portfolio to life with JavaScript. Learn the fundamentals of the language and how to manipulate the DOM to create interactive user experiences.
objectives: Understand variables, functions, arrays, and objects
Select and modify DOM elements dynamically
Add event listeners for clicks, hovers, and keyboard input
Build a dark mode toggle for your portfolio

days.title: Responsive Design & Media Queries
days.description: Make your portfolio fully responsive. Learn mobile-first design principles, media queries, and viewport units to ensure your site looks great on every screen size.
objectives: Implement mobile-first CSS with min-width media queries
Use relative units (rem, em, %, vw, vh) instead of fixed px
Create a responsive navigation (hamburger menu on mobile)
Test across multiple screen sizes using DevTools

days.title: Git Workflow & Collaboration
days.description: Master the Git workflow used in real teams. Learn branching strategies, how to handle merge conflicts, and how to write meaningful commit messages that tell a story.
objectives: Create feature branches and merge them to main
Simulate and resolve a merge conflict
Write conventional commit messages (feat:, fix:, docs:)
Set up a .gitignore for your project

days.title: CSS Grid & Advanced Layouts
days.description: Level up your layout skills with CSS Grid. Build complex, two-dimensional layouts that would be impossible with Flexbox alone. Redesign your portfolio's project showcase section.
objectives: Create a responsive grid layout for project cards
Use grid-template-areas for semantic layouts
Combine Grid and Flexbox for maximum flexibility
Add CSS animations to your project cards

days.title: Introduction to React
days.description: Enter the world of modern frontend frameworks. Set up a React project, understand JSX, and build your first components. This is where your projects start feeling like real applications.
objectives: Create a new React project with Vite
Understand JSX syntax and how it compiles
Build functional components for Header, Footer, and Card
Pass and render data using props

days.title: React Components & Composition
days.description: Master component architecture. Learn to break down UIs into reusable components, use composition patterns, and pass children to create flexible layouts.
objectives: Break your UI into a clear component hierarchy
Use children props for layout components
Create a reusable Button component with variants
Implement conditional rendering patterns

days.title: State Management & Hooks
days.description: Learn to manage dynamic data in React with useState and useEffect. Build interactive features like counters, form inputs, and data fetching with proper cleanup.
objectives: Use useState for local component state
Use useEffect for side effects and data fetching
Lift state up to share data between components
Handle loading and error states gracefully

days.title: API Integration & Data Fetching
days.description: Connect your React app to the real world. Learn to fetch data from REST APIs, handle async operations, and display dynamic content with proper loading and error handling.
objectives: Fetch data from a public API using fetch()
Display API data in a clean, styled list/grid
Implement loading spinners and error messages
Add search/filter functionality on fetched data

days.title: Build a REST API with Express
days.description: Switch to the backend. Build a complete REST API with Node.js and Express. Learn routing, middleware, request handling, and how to structure a backend project professionally.
objectives: Set up an Express.js server with proper project structure
Create CRUD endpoints (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE)
Implement middleware for logging and error handling
Test your API endpoints with Postman or Thunder Client

days.title: Database Design with MongoDB
days.description: Learn NoSQL database fundamentals with MongoDB. Design schemas using Mongoose, connect your Express API to a database, and implement persistent data storage.
objectives: Set up MongoDB Atlas (free tier) cloud database
Design Mongoose schemas and models
Connect Express API to MongoDB
Implement database CRUD operations

days.title: Authentication & JWT Security
days.description: Implement secure user authentication. Learn about password hashing, JSON Web Tokens, and protected routes to build applications that handle user identity safely.
objectives: Hash passwords with bcrypt before storing
Generate and verify JWT tokens for sessions
Create login and registration endpoints
Protect routes with authentication middleware

tracks.name: Full Stack Development
tracks.description: Build complete web applications from frontend to backend. HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Node.js, databases, and deployment.

tracks.name: AI & Machine Learning
tracks.description: Learn ML fundamentals, build models with Python, and deploy intelligent applications. NumPy, Pandas, TensorFlow, and more.

tracks.name: Mobile Development
tracks.description: Create cross-platform mobile apps with React Native or Flutter. UI design, navigation, APIs, and app store deployment.

tracks.name: DevOps & Cloud
tracks.description: Master CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms. Deploy and scale applications like a pro.

testimonials.name: Priya Patel
testimonials.quote: Before ABTalks, I had zero projects on my GitHub. 60 days later, I had a portfolio that got me an internship at a Bangalore startup. The daily consistency changed everything.
testimonials.outcome: Secured SDE Intern at a Series A startup

testimonials.name: Rohit Menon
testimonials.quote: The LinkedIn posts from the challenge got me 12K impressions in a month. Two recruiters reached out directly. Building in public works — ABTalks made it a habit.
testimonials.outcome: ML Intern at a Big 4 consulting firm

testimonials.name: Sneha Gupta
testimonials.quote: I used to start projects and abandon them after 3 days. The streak system and the community kept me accountable. I completed all 60 days and learned more than an entire semester.
